Create a new mpaqt_index object

Source: R/class-index.R
new_mpaqt_index.Rd

Internal constructor for mpaqt_index objects. Users should use mpaqt_index() to create indices from FASTA/GTF files.

new_mpaqt_index(
  transcripts,
  genes,
  ec_ids,
  p_matrices,
  ec_counts = NULL,
  covariates = NULL,
  distances = NULL,
  t2g_matrix = NULL,
  g2t_matrix = NULL,
  t2g_normalized = NULL,
  kallisto_index = NULL,
  gtf_annotation = NULL,
  transcriptome_seqs = NULL,
  kallisto_binary = NULL
)

Arguments

transcripts

Character vector of transcript IDs

genes

Character vector of gene IDs (same length as transcripts)

ec_ids

Character vector of equivalence class IDs

p_matrices

List of probability data.tables (one per transcript)

ec_counts

Named numeric vector of EC read counts from simulation

covariates

Matrix of transcript covariates

distances

Data.table of distance information

t2g_matrix

Sparse transcript-to-gene matrix

g2t_matrix

Sparse gene-to-transcript matrix

t2g_normalized

Normalized transcript-to-gene matrix

kallisto_index

Path to kallisto index file (optional)

gtf_annotation

GTF annotation data.table (optional, for LR workflows)

transcriptome_seqs

Transcriptome sequences (optional, for LR workflows)

kallisto_binary

Raw binary content of kallisto index (for bundled indices)

Value

An object of class mpaqt_index
